name: AutoBattler
description: v2.6.1: contact-avoidance fix (third play-test feedback) -- the bot no longer drifts into a monster and orbits it: the crowding terms projected a chasing body with its frozen velocity and could price running away as MORE crowded than orbiting, so the bot held a stable orbit on top of one chaser taking contact hits; the projection now tracks outrunnable pursuers (--arb-roomtrack=0 rolls back). Also: a winding-up charger's frozen body is now priced (--arb-windup=0), and the contact reach can no longer under-estimate elites/bosses/DLC non-circle hitboxes (--arb-hitbox=0). Movement-only autopilot for Brotato (MIT fork of BOTato, tested on 1.2.0.1). Auto-moves/dodges/collects during waves; every decision stays manual. Behaviour priors are inferred from measured build traits (no per-character table needed). v2.6.0: space planning — retreats from the wall band before a crowd squeezes it shut, a weak open-floor potential against edge drift; bounty approach toward special targets (bosses/elites, spawner eggs, cursed/evolved); item crates priced as items and loot aliens worth a detour. v2.5.0: planning layer — pre-emptive breakout from a closing encirclement (future-freedom rollout + committed escape), committed high-value item goals (DLC evolution fruits, hurt fruit, trees) with a walk-on pickup fix and end-of-wave urgency; pursuit-aware second ply. All new behaviour has exact opt-out flags. v2.4.0: DLC-aware engage stances for cursed/evolved enemies + evolution item pickup. v2.3.0: ranged standoff, trees/hurt fruit, 2-ply planner + hit-adaptive caution. Toggle with Shift+Space.
